[P2] Provide negative tests for the new package guard

CONTRIBUTING rule 4 requires a test that fails when each added branch is removed. No automated tests exercise this script's rejection paths; the CI invocation checks the valid package only. Deleting this `sideEffects` check would therefore leave the checks passing. The reported manual declaration-map probe does not cover this condition or test declarations. Return to the validation design under rules 8–9 and include negative fixtures proving each rejection condition before retaining the guard.
